message:
## Vulnerability Digest

One newly reported vulnerability was confirmed as relevant to the products in `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` during the 24-hour window from 2026-09-26 23:40 UTC to 2026-09-27 23:40 UTC.

### Finding 1 — hMailServer JScript event-script eval injection

- **Affected product/component:** Progressive Robot Ltd hMailServer for Windows, versions 6.0.0 through 6.3.3
- **Vulnerability:** CVE-2026-100741 (CWE-95)
- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS 3.1 score 9.8
- **Description:** A remote unauthenticated attacker can inject JScript through crafted authentication or mail-protocol data, causing code to run with the hMailServer service account's privileges.
- **Conditions:** The primary logon path requires event scripting to be enabled, JScript selected, and an `OnClientValidatePassword` handler configured. The advisory also describes POP3 and SMTP delivery paths under specific event-handler configurations. VBScript event scripts and Linux builds are not affected.
- **Why relevant:** hMailServer is explicitly present in the monitored product list. The affected implementation is the Progressive Robot maintained fork, so deployed product lineage, version, operating system, and scripting configuration should be verified.
- **Sources:** [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-v6j4-p35g-mq6p); [vendor fix commit](https://gitlab.com/Progressiverobot/hmailserver/-/commit/5a3de9001d6c5e833662ada8e44ce10d42d76b1a); [vendor 6.3.4 release](https://gitlab.com/Progressiverobot/hmailserver/-/releases/v6.3.4)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries and services. No qualifying new MongoDB-family advisory was confirmed in the scan window. CVE-2026-9754 was reposted by a third party on September 27 but was originally disclosed by MongoDB on June 9, so it was excluded as stale.

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended for any Progressive Robot hMailServer deployment on Windows. Confirm whether the affected versions and event-script configurations are present and consult the vendor's 6.3.4 release. No other candidate met all freshness, source-credibility, and product-matching requirements for this run.
